test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'BREAD' is coded as RBBDA and 'FLOUR' is coded as LFLRU. How will 'PAINT' be coded in the same language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic : 

 
• First two letters → Interchanged positions
 
• Third letter→ (3) is subtracted from the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Last two letters → Interchanged positions

So,

 
• 'BREAD' is coded as RBBDA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/48c675ae3c0c723bc538637971277108e9ef2bb0f2b781cd0d6141d707476494.png] 

And,

 
• 'FLOUR' is coded as LFLRU

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/34f06b673f59e53000bbe27cab0372b538f0e358f1393060e0a0aac3b95fa9e0.png] 

​Similarly,

 
• 'PAINT' will be coded as :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a88662ecf1482aa9d04d7f0facfcef488d7d6c01e80f42da84607fd0256b9f53.png] 

​Hence, "**APFTN**" is the correct answer.

7c
